fields.why: Hospitalization and death percentages are reported for Hispanic, Black and White patients (overall and within age strata), an outcome measured in each of 3 race/ethnicity groups.
Age enters the text only as <60 vs >=60 (a pair) or as Table 1 composition, and homelessness is binary, so race/ethnicity is the only groupwise dimension.
The methods state that no statistical testing was performed, so every race comparison is side by side.
